data.name: Appu
data.long_meaning: The name Appu is derived from the Tamil word 'appadi' which means 'small' or 'petite'. It is also a common nickname for children named Appadurai, Appan, or Arapporan. In Hindu mythology, Appu is also the name of a celestial being associated with the Sun and represents energy, power, and vitality.
